verdict.rationale: Community Phone's own port-landline guide documents every element of the story. It collects the losing carrier's PIN, account number and billing address plus a Letter of Authorization, validates them with the current provider, and then runs the port itself with a dedicated rep in 3-5 business days, free and without a service gap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the porting process, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: You will have to share information such as - PIN, Account number, Billing address as registered with the current provider, and a Letter of Authorization to Community Phone. Once this information has been validated with your current provider, the porting process will begin.
Community Phone will port your number in 3-5 business days without disrupting your service.
Once you indicate that you want to port your number, you will be assigned a dedicated representative from Community Phone who will be your contact throughout the process.
Number transfer (porting) from any carrier is free and takes about 5 business days.
